adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` the new logic in `createAllCalendarEvents` (around the added `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } })`) will load an arbitrary credential by id if it is not already present in `this.calendarCredentials`, and then uses it to call `createEvent(...)`. The DB lookup has no `userId`/`teamId`/org scoping check, so if a `DestinationCalendar` object contains a foreign `credentialId`, the flow would attempt to create calendar events using that credential’s OAuth token. This security/authorization gap is directly introduced by the diff (previously it only used credentials from `this.calendarCredentials`).
